report_name: Hart District Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP)
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to identify routes with the greatest potential for increased cycling (commuter and school trips), to test the emerging network, and to provide evidence for the network planning process.
other_tools_developed: A prioritisation methodology was developed by Hampshire County Council, using a scoring system of 1 to 3 across four categories (Effectiveness, Policy, Economics, Deliverability) to rank routes and zones.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP has informed the development of the Green Grid, including the pilot route between Hartland Village and Fleet Railway Station (opened Summer 2022), and serves as a strategic document to enable the Council to bid for central Government funding for active travel infrastructure.
pct_usage_quote: In addition to the clustering exercise, the PCT has been used to identify which routes within the study area have the greatest potential for an increase in the number of commuters cycling to work and the number of children cycling to school.
